[[File:Art Wright DecipherCon 2002.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Art Wright at DecipherCon 2002.]]
'''Art Wright''' is a member of [[Team Albany]]. He and [[Aaron Kingery]] flew to Kissimmee early for [[DecipherCon 2000]]. He was in the open-gaming room when the Terwilligers arrived Wednesday night; [[Chris Terwilliger]] played pickup games with him that night. Sokol saw him on the Day 2 morning. With Kingery and [[Brian Terwilliger]] he built [[Matt Sokol]]'s Day 3 [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] list overnight. Team Albany, including Wright, wished Sokol luck before Day 3.<ref name="sokol-dt">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-11-sokols-dcon-2000-reportd1327/ sokols-dcon-2000-report], Matt Sokol, Decktech (11 October 2000)</ref>
